entities.summary: Laila El-Haddad is a Palestinian author and public speaker based in the United States. She lectures on Gaza, the intersection of food and politics, and contemporary Islam. She is also a policy advisor with Al-Shabaka: the Palestinian Policy Network. Laila el-Haddad was a painters & sculptors from Kuwait (b. 1978, Kuwait). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
